why: Burungale-Skinner-Tian-Wan (arXiv 2601.16044, and prior work it builds on) establish the first infinite families of quadratic twists of non-CM elliptic curves over Q for which the full strong BSD conjecture is proven, by settling the p-part of BSD at supersingular primes. Numerous other 2025 preprints (Zenodo, SSRN, preprints.org) claim complete proofs of BSD but show no signs of peer review or community acceptance and read as likely cranks.
queries: Burungale Skinner Tian Wan Birch Swinnerton-Dyer quadratic twists infinite family

found.title: On the Identification of Elliptic Curves That Admit Infinitely Many Twists Satisfying the Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
found.note: Builds on Burungale-Skinner-Tian-Wan to identify elliptic curves of conductor up to 500,000 admitting infinitely many quadratic twists for which the full strong BSD conjecture is proven; not read in full.

found.title: Proof of the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture (Shimizu)
found.note: Preprint claiming an unconditional complete proof of BSD for all ranks; self-published on Zenodo, marked as a working draft, no evidence of peer review.

found.title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture via Relational Field Theory: A Formal Proof of Rank Prediction through Coherence (Svancara)
found.note: SSRN preprint claiming a proof; not read, appears non-mainstream/unreviewed.

found.title: A Complete Proof of the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture via the Iran Formula
found.note: Preprints.org submission claiming a complete proof via a novel 'Iran Formula'; unreviewed.

found.title: A Proof of the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
found.note: Zenodo preprint claiming a complete proof covering analytic rank and the leading L-function coefficient; unreviewed.
